outcomes.title: What happened to graduates
outcomes.incomeHidden: Income isn't published — fewer than 30 employed graduates (data protection).
outcomes.caveat: This covers all of this university's graduates in this field and study level, not this specific programme, and even within one field the spread between graduates is wide — treat it as a pointer, not a promise. Income is total annual income (including part-time work) for employed graduates only; employment is determined as of November. Some bachelor's graduates go on to study, which lowers their employment share.

footer.disclaimer: Studet is an independent informational portal, not a university or a government body — we have no contractual relationship with the universities listed here. Programme descriptions, deadlines, fees and competition-score formulas come from each university's own publicly available sources and may be outdated or inaccurate; every programme card states whether a fact was checked by a person or extracted automatically. Always verify current information on the university's official website before making a decision — only the university makes the final admission decision.
